params.name: Mule
params.note: A DHC-6 Twin Otter: a long pointed baggage nose, a square cabin with seven windows a side, a strut-braced high wing with double-slotted flaps, two PT6 turboprops slung under it with their exhaust stacks bent aft, fixed tricycle gear on stubs, and a tall straight fin with a dorsal fillet. Drawn in the frame of the fw_prop row, so the interior and the lamps still sit where they did.
